name: pm-china-parents
description: The Chinese parents pack (家长): school entry planning for 幼升小 and 小升初 (timeline, documents, 学区 and 多校划片 questions, marked to confirm locally), polite home-school messages to teachers (家校沟通), an extracurricular plan checked against the 双减 rules, time and budget, and guiding rather than doing a child's homework, written in Chinese
